tools.name: bridge_remember
tools.description: Store a memory. Auto-routes short atomic facts (under ~200 chars) to Mind concept graph; longer content to Honcho semantic vector store. Use target='mind' or target='honcho' to override routing.

target.description: Where to store: auto (default, routes by length), mind, or honcho

tools.name: bridge_recall
tools.description: Unified recall across Mind (concept graph, spreading activation) and Honcho (semantic vector search). Results merged with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60) and labelled with source system.

query.description: The question or topic to recall

tools.name: bridge_status
tools.description: Combined health report for Mind, Honcho, and Episodic memory systems. Reports node/edge counts from Mind, conclusion count from Honcho, episode count from Episodic store, and availability of each system.

tools.name: bridge_episode_record
tools.description: Record a session episode to the episodic memory timeline. Stores what happened, decisions made, files touched, and outcome. Also auto-stores a short summary in Mind for cross-system recall.

summary.description: One-line summary of what happened this session

details.description: Longer description of the session's work

decisions.description: Key decisions made during the session

outcome.description: The result or outcome of the session

tools.name: bridge_episode_recall
tools.description: Search the episodic memory timeline. Find past sessions by text search over summaries/details/decisions, filtered by time range. Results ranked by relevance score.

query.description: Text to search for in episode summaries, details, and decisions

time_from.description: ISO datetime string (e.g. '2026-06-01T00:00:00Z'). Only return episodes after this time.

time_to.description: ISO datetime string. Only return episodes before this time.

tag.description: Filter by tag (e.g. 'memory-bridge'). Only return episodes with this tag.

tools.name: bridge_timeline
tools.description: Get the chronological timeline of session episodes. Returns episodes in reverse chronological order (newest first). Use this to see what work was done and when.

tools.name: bridge_synthesize
tools.description: Cortex Accelerator: synthesize knowledge across Mind and Honcho. Recalls everything known about a topic from both memory systems, clusters related memories, and generates a concise synthesis. Uses local LLM (Ollama qwen3:8b) when available for better summaries; falls back to extractive key-sentence selection. The synthesis is auto-stored in Mind as a high-weight fact.

topic.description: The topic to synthesize knowledge about

store.description: Whether to store the synthesis back into Mind (default true)

use_llm.description: Use local LLM for synthesis (default true, falls back to extractive)

tools.name: bridge_contradictions
tools.description: Detect potentially contradictory memories in the knowledge base. Scans Mind for pairs where one statement negates the other (heuristic: significant word overlap + negation words in one but not the other). Optionally uses local LLM to validate contradictions.

use_llm.description: Use local LLM to validate detected contradictions (default true)
